declarations.description:
A main action with a caret that opens a menu of alternatives: "Send ▾", "Merge pull request ▾", or a microphone
toggle with its device menu. The two halves are two native buttons, so the control has two tab stops; the caret is a
menu button (Enter, Space or ArrowDown open the menu on the first row, ArrowUp on the last, Escape closes it and
returns focus) and the menu is a `c2-menu` anchored to the whole control, never narrower than it.

In the default `fixed` mode the main action never changes: activating it fires `action`, picking a row fires
`menu-select`. In `choice` mode the rows are radios: the checked one names the main half and is the control's
`value`, and picking another changes the choice (`input` then `change`) instead of running it.

Use it only when one action is clearly the most common; otherwise a `c2-button-group` or a `c2-menu` with a button
trigger says more. Listen for `action`, not `click`: clicks on the menu rows bubble through the host.
declarations.name: SplitButton

cssProperties.description: Width of the control. `100%` makes the main half grow.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button--width

cssProperties.description: Space between the halves. `0px` joins them with a divider; a gap rounds the inner corners too.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button--gap

cssProperties.description: Inner corners. Defaults to square when joined and to the outer radius when split.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button--inner-border-radius

cssProperties.description: Colour changes and the chevron turn. `0s` under reduced motion.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__transition--duration

cssProperties.description: Space between the icon and the label.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__main--gap

cssProperties.description: The main half's edge against the caret. `none` lets an outlined caret's border be the seam.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__main--border-right

cssProperties.description: Pressed state of a `toggle` main half.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__main__selected--background-color

cssProperties.description: Caret width on a touch screen.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__caret--min-width-coarse

cssProperties.description: The caret while the menu is open.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__caret__open--background-color

cssProperties.description: The caret's corners while open, e.g. the outer radius for a split caret that becomes a pill.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__caret__open--border-radius

cssProperties.description: Turn of the caret icon while open. `0deg` for an icon that should not turn.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__caret__icon__open--rotate

cssProperties.description: Hidden when the halves have a gap.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__divider--width

cssProperties.description: Space left above and below the divider.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__divider--inset

cssProperties.description: The whole control, or the main half alone under `main-disabled`.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__disabled--opacity

cssProperties.description: Floor for the menu, which is never narrower than the control.
cssProperties.name: --c2-split-button__menu--min-width

cssParts.description: The native button of the main action.
cssParts.name: main

cssParts.description: The native button that opens the menu.
cssParts.name: caret

slots.description: The main half's label. Ignored in choice mode, where the chosen row names it.
slots.name: default

slots.description: Icon before the label. Replaced by `running-icon` while `running` is set.
slots.name: prefix-icon

slots.description: Shown in place of the prefix icon while `running`. Defaults to a spinner; the wrapper rotates.
slots.name: running-icon

slots.description: The caret's icon. Defaults to a chevron, which turns while the menu is open.
slots.name: caret-icon

slots.description: The rows: `c2-menu-item` elements, `<hr>` separators and `<h1>`–`<h6>` group headings.
slots.name: menu

members.name: mode
members.description: `fixed`: the main action never changes. `choice`: the rows are radios and the checked one is the main action.

members.name: value
members.description: Fixed mode: submitted with `name` when the main half submits a form. Choice mode: the chosen row's `value`.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name submitted with `value`. Reflects: a form-associated element is submitted under its `name` attribute.

members.name: type
members.description: What the main half does in a form.

members.name: label
members.description: Accessible name of the main half when it shows only an icon, or when its text is not its name.

members.name: caretLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the caret. Defaults to "More {label} options", or "More options" without a label.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables both halves.

members.name: mainDisabled
members.description: Disables only the main half: it stays focusable and announced, and the menu stays usable.

members.name: running
members.description: Marks the main half as busy: the `running-icon` shows and activation is ignored. The caret still works.

members.name: toggle
members.description: Makes the main half a toggle button (`aria-pressed`), e.g. mute.

members.name: selected
members.description: Pressed state of a `toggle` main half. Activating the main half flips it.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the menu is open. Set it to open or close the menu from code.

members.name: placement
members.description: Preferred placement of the menu (floating-ui names); it flips near the viewport edge.

members.name: mainText
members.description: Text of the default slot, for the caret's name.

members.name: chosenLabel
members.description: Name of the chosen row in choice mode. A state set after the first update, so a server render matches.

members.name: pendingFocus
members.description: Which row the menu should focus when it next opens.

members.name: menuItems
members.description: The `c2-menu-item` rows slotted into `menu`.

members.name: form
members.description: The associated form, matching the native button API.

members.name: chosenItem
members.description: Choice mode: the row whose `value` is `value`, else the first enabled row.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the menu. Pass `'last'` to start on the last row, `'none'` to leave focus where it is.

members.name: toggleMenu
members.description: Opens the menu when closed and closes it when open.

members.name: focus
members.description: Focuses the main half.

members.name: focusCaret
members.description: Focuses the caret.

members.name: syncChoices
members.description: Marks the rows as choices in choice mode (a property, never an attribute on the author's rows) and names the main half.

members.name: handleMenuClick
members.description: The caret's own click is the menu's business; only `action` speaks for the control.

events.description: The main half was activated while available. Cancelable: cancelling it also cancels a form submit or reset.
events.name: action

events.description: A row was activated (from `c2-menu-item`, unchanged). In choice mode, `preventDefault()` keeps the current choice.
events.name: menu-select

events.description: Choice mode: a pick changed `value`. Fires before `change`.
events.name: input

events.description: Choice mode: a pick changed `value`. Not fired when `value` is set from code.
events.name: change

events.description: The menu opened or closed; `newState` is `open` or `closed`.
events.name: toggle
